description.text: The courses for the undergraduates mainly focus on Chinese language, Chinese literature and arts, including the primary, middle and advanced Chinese classes, basic skills of Chinese listening, speaking, reading, writing, Journal Reading and Translating, and History of China, History of Literature, Philosophy, History of Arts, Geography, and Economics, etc. Chinese Language Direction Training Purpose: Know basic theory and knowledge of Chinese well; Posses the steady ability of Chinese language and communication; Know basic Chinese general knowledge and social customs; Cultivate initial Chinese research and practical working ability, after graduation students are qualified in doing diplomacy, international exchange, Chinese teaching or secretary, etc. Major Courses: Advanced Chinese, Advanced Speaking, Chinese Writing, Chinese Topics, Modern Chinese Vocabulary, Modern Chinese Grammar, Modern Chinese Rhetoric and Ancient Chinese.

duration.text: The Chinese Language at Zhengzhou University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2430 USD/per year ￥ 17500 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 6. Two teachers' recommendation letters 7. Certification of no criminal record

requirements.text: No requirement for Chinese, high school diploma or the equivalence, healthy, no criminal record, and of the age from 18 to 30.
